I am old now, 78 years, and this small maize plot of mine is close to the house. Here in Iringa the rains are good and the soil is not bad, but I do not have much money for fertilizer like the big farmers in Mbeya. I will put a little manure from my few animals, and maybe a small bag of urea if I can get it, and I plant together with beans as I always do. My sons help me with the digging because my back is not strong anymore.
